turns.answer:
Monday's card error was on the Stripe docs error-codes page (screenshot at 11:05, Nov 2) — the code listed there was:

**`expired card`** — "The card has expired. Check the expiration date or use a different card."

Right next to it on the same list was **`expired_payment_method`** — "The payment method expired. Check the expiration date or use a different payment method."

If you were actually chasing something in your own code rather than reading the docs, the other morning screens were the `ingest-platform` Slack thread (10:52, the 502/retry-budget discussion) and a `pytest -q tests/test_worker.py` run at 09:40 — no payment errors in either.
